instruction: Change the formatting of the slide numbers at the bottom in LibreOffice Impress to make them stand out by applying a blue color scheme.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the slide number color to blue in LibreOffice Impress. Uses existing check_page_number_colors metric function that checks the slide master's page number color. The evaluator verifies that the slide number color meets the blue threshold (B > R+50 and B > G+50).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses 'rules["color"]' to access the color parameter (no incorrect 'rules.get("rules")' pattern)
Function check_page_number_colors correctly parses slide master XML to extract page number color from slideMaster1.xml
Blue color validation logic is appropriate: checks B > R+50 AND B > G+50, which correctly identifies blue tones
Postconfig appropriately saves the file with Ctrl+S before extraction, ensuring changes are persisted
Evaluator semantically verifies the instruction requirement: slide number color is blue
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: The function uses 'color_elems[-2]' to extract slide number color, which assumes a specific XML structure. This is fragile and may fail with different presentation templates that have different numbers of color elements in the slide master
Consider adding validation that the extracted color element actually corresponds to the page number placeholder rather than relying on positional indexing
